tei:div.tei:p: gzhi bdag rten bkol skabs/ thog mar thugs sgrub las byang tshogs skong bcas dang*/ dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bsang*/ gser skyems rnams grub nas gsas mkhar brtsig pa'i 'og gi ri zhabs thag nye ring gang bder yul 'dre mnan pa gzhung ltar/ de nas gsas mkhar brtsig sa dngos der gser skyems dang*/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor bshams la sa slong dang*/ sa srin bskrad/ sa rgod yin na lto 'phye brtag pa grub na legs/ de min gsas mkhar rtsig pa'i 'og gzhir gzhal yas khang pa mtshon byed pad+ma 'dab brgyad bting*/ de steng bum pa bzhag /tshas dang kha chod legs par brgyabs pa'i rtser rgyab tu dar cog /mgul du 'khor lo yod pa'i gwa'u/ mdun du shing byang*/ gzhan yang shing rtsi bal tshon sogs btsugs/ dmu thag 'then zhes pa shing byang rtse nas tshon skud gsas mkhar phyogs bzhir 'then/ dkar gtor dang nyer spyod/ bsang dang*/ gser skyems sogs bsham/ sbyong ba dang*/ ri khrus gter gsar lugs ltar bya/ de nas sngags drug phyag drug nas gzung gzhung ltar tshang bar btang la mthar/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi sogs gter gsar bsngo smon dang*/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin lta bu'i bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ de nas brngan sogs bsang gi mjug dang*/ tshogs la rol pa/ lhag ma sogs las byang mtha' bsdus grub bo// zhes pa'ang gter chen nyid kyi phyag bzhes te gu ṇas so// dge legs 'phel/// /
